The main takeaway from our work is that
the friction factor of the PFCI conductor in the ITER design can be estimated using the Katheder correlation.
the longitudinal friction factor is a key parameter to predict the pressure drop of ITER PFCI conductors and should be determined with sufficient accuracy.
